commandIngress.reason: The firmware forwards every non-response topic under the wildcard filter and does not select one server command leaf.

commandResponse.override: Accepted only through the firmware response_topic validator; server must not use an unvalidated override.

genericOutboundPublisher.role: Explicit-topic transport service, not command-leaf selection.
genericOutboundPublisher.serverRelease1Policy: PRIMARY_ONLY; server rejects SECONDARY_ONLY, BOTH and FAILOVER until a separate fixture-backed contract passes.
genericOutboundPublisher.limitation: This API proves outbound validation only. It does not prove that any particular server leaf reaches the command dispatcher.
